page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet. Top right, the e-rara logo. Centred below, the website name, the title and imprint of the digitised book, the library and shelf mark, and the persistent link. Below a horizontal rule, a block of multilingual terms-of-use text in small type. At the bottom right, the Visual Library logo.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. It carries the e-rara logo, the title and imprint of the digitised book (Methodus facilima ad explicationem sacrosanctae apocalypseos Joannis theologi, by N. Colladon, Morges 1584; Bibliothèque de Genève, shelf mark Bb 2233), the persistent link, and the terms-of-use notices in German, English, French and Italian. None of this is printed text of the book, so it is left out.
